institution: Schools in Paris and Geneva; gymnasium in Bratislava
detail: Spent part of his childhood abroad and was educated in Paris and Geneva before completing secondary school at a gymnasium in Bratislava.

institution: University of Economics in Bratislava (Vysoká škola ekonomická, today Ekonomická univerzita v Bratislave), Faculty of Commerce
detail: Studied international trade at the Faculty of Commerce and graduated in 1978; his diploma thesis dealt with the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the liberalisation of international trade. He was active in the student organisation AIESEC.
